split: official test set (10,000 images, sealed until RUN_FINAL_TEST=True)
rule: no model, K, threshold or setting is changed after test results are seen (R7)

metrics: Shirt-vs-rest: ROC AUC, and TPR/FPR/precision/expected cost at the frozen LR thresholds

part5_2_ensemble.rule: equal-weight average of the three softmax vectors; predict the argmax (lowest class index if tied)
metrics: accuracy of each member and of the ensemble with 95% Wilson interval
exact McNemar test of the ensemble against each member on identical images

parts_4_and_5_1_clustering.test_subset: cluster_test_idx (1,000 stratified images of the official test array)
parts_4_and_5_1_clustering.frozen_centres: K-means, seed 2208, best of 10 random starts, fitted on the 3,000 training images: raw pixels, and final-hidden-layer features of the seed-2208 network of the selected MLP
metrics: purity (each cluster mapped to its training majority class)
